newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 30.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 30.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Friday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.
Local weather reports did warn of warm winds in the northern region. The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings
for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.

Warm temperatures and clear skies. Rains and thunder storms expected along the southern coast later in the day. Winds of 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves three to six feet high.
Some clouds along Campeche Sound and Yucatan peninsula. Mostly clear skies and predominant winds from 10 to 15 knots and waves three to five feet high. -- Caribbean:
Hot and partly cloudy with scattered rains. Winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
